title: Programme Office Determination on the Standing of a Belrose Circle Membership Programme Membership
content:
# Programme Office Determination — Standing of a Belrose Circle Membership Programme Membership: Suspension, Reinstatement, Closure and Fees

## Determination

1. A Belrose Circle Membership Programme membership is suspended while its earning is looked into, and the review is finished within the days the tier sets.
2. A suspension is lifted, and the membership resumed, only while it stands at suspended or already active.
3. A membership closes at the member's own request, or after a lapsed membership has sat unreclaimed past the review period.
4. An enrolment fee and an annual fee are charged at the tiers that carry them, and a tier whose annual fee goes unpaid is moved down rather than suspended.
5. The closure itself is confirmed by the member, because giving up a membership and the points on it is theirs alone to do.
6. The enrolment fee and the annual fee are rung at the till on their own sales receipt rather than booked against the points balance, and neither of them is qualifying spend, so paying to hold a tier never earns points toward keeping it.

## Basis of paragraph 2

The status is read from the membership record held by the company, against the membership number, before the suspension is lifted.

| Status recorded on the membership | Suspension may be lifted and the membership resumed |
|---|---|
| suspended | yes |
| active | yes |
| enrolled | no |
| review pending | no |
| lapsed | no |
| closed | no |

## States of a membership

| State | Meaning |
|---|---|
| enrolled | the membership has been opened and has not yet begun earning |
| active | the membership is earning |
| review pending | the membership year has closed and the tier has come up for review |
| lapsed | the membership went the inactivity period without qualifying spend |
| suspended | the membership is suspended while its earning is looked into |
| closed | the membership has closed |

A membership moves from enrolled to active when it begins earning, and from enrolled to closed when the customer withdraws before it has begun earning. It moves from active to review pending when the membership year closes and from review pending to active when the review is settled; from active to lapsed when it goes the inactivity period without qualifying spend, and from lapsed back to active when the member has spent enough to bring it back to life. It moves from active to suspended while its earning is looked into, from suspended to active when the review finishes and it resumes, and from suspended to closed on the outcome of the review. It moves from active to closed when the member closes it, and from lapsed to closed when a lapsed membership is closed after the review period. A closure is recorded with the date it closed. The points balance on a membership is the number of points the member holds, increased by earning and bonuses and decreased by spending, by reversals on returns and by expiry.

## Applications of the determination (hypothetical)

- A membership standing at suspended, with the review finished: the suspension is lifted and the membership resumes, its next review date recorded.
- A membership standing at lapsed, on which a suspension is asked to be lifted: paragraph 2 does not permit it, because a lapsed membership stands at neither suspended nor active.
- A member of a tier carrying an annual fee whose annual fee goes unpaid: the membership is moved down a tier, not suspended.
- A member of a tier carrying an enrolment fee pays it at the till on its own sales receipt: no points are credited on that receipt, because the fee is not qualifying spend.
